retained_foundations: FBE12–17 derive the four regular group actions, the shifted determinant, compact terminal form and the scalar germ on prescribed reversing heads. The signed compact type conventions and the interpolation budget are those of B8.10e.

FBE18–19 transfer the germ to the compact cut kernel using the two specified residual tail integrals, with density and word normalization retained. A full derivation still needs these weighted bounds over the entire residual group and the derivative majorants for removing the auxiliary smooth cutoff on the original discrete-series coefficient. Finiteness for individual compact tests does not give uniform constants in that passage.

formal_consumer.scope: FBE12–19 compute the original regular group actions, fixed-head germ, terminal signed pairing and normalized annular limits on the positive compact cut. The intermediate residual tail estimates and noncompact differentiated cutoff pass remain explicit analytic inputs.
